home.title: Events on disk, in order.
home.description: An event-streaming broker in one Rust binary. Durable by default, and it still moves millions of records a second.

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Topics, partitions, offsets and consumer groups in one Rust binary, alone or as a Raft cluster.

demo.title: Quickstart
demo.description: Build es, start a broker on your machine, and write and read your first records.

api.title: HTTP and binary API
api.description: Every operation over HTTP and JSON, with produce and consume also over a binary protocol.

cli.title: CLI and broker flags
cli.description: The es command-line client, and every es-broker flag with its default.

storage.title: How storage works
storage.description: Segments and CRCs, group commit, crash recovery, retention and compaction.

cluster.title: Clustering with Raft
cluster.description: Three brokers, every partition replicated, each write acknowledged once a majority has it.

tools.title: Backup and restore
tools.description: Copy a broker's data into one archive and restore it on any machine, checked before anything is replaced.
